data.body:
SUPERSEDED by epic 5664-b797-60b9-49ef (soupy-bilineate-whiteeye), "CI practice & coverage
parity with mainstream Python OSS, latency-neutral". As the CI owner, I have actioned this
research handoff into an actionable epic; per this ticket's AC-2 ("any adopted item exists as
its own ticket"), each adopted finding becomes a child story of 5664.

Per-finding disposition (satisfying AC-1):
- Widen zizmor beyond release.yml -> ADOPTED (5664 S1). Re-verified: Makefile:243-244 still
  scopes zizmor to RELEASE_WORKFLOW only.
- SHA-pin third-party actions / fix the false claim -> ADOPTED (5664 S2). Re-verified:
  gerrit-verify.yaml:21 claims all SHA-pinned, but setup-python@v7 (76,175) and
  _build-and-test.yml checkout@v7 / setup-python@v7 (50,58,249,257,319,328) are mutable.
- twine check dist/* pre-merge -> ADOPTED (5664 S3). Re-verified: absent from _artifact-probe.yml.
- Scheduled-sweep breadth (intermediate Python, Windows, pre-release interpreters, dependency
  lower-bound resolution, external doc link check, full macOS suite) -> ADOPTED to the scheduled
  lane (5664 S5), non-blocking, zero hot-path cost.
- CodeQL on the exact Gerrit refspec + vote.needs -> FLAGGED as an explicit owner latency
  decision (5664, dedicated AC); default recommendation keep scheduled/non-gating. Not
  auto-adopted (the one item that adds real pre-merge minutes).
- Coverage floor toward 100% -> DEFERRED with the ticket's own reasoning (mutation testing is
  the stronger oracle); instead ADOPTED diff-coverage on changed lines as the OSS-aligned
  coverage step (5664 S4).
- Downstream-consumer testing -> DEFERRED (premature until public integrations exist).

Closing as superseded; the actionable successor is 5664.
